_comment: Template only. release/package-assets.mjs writes the real RELEASE-MANIFEST.json into assets/. Do not hand-edit hashes into this file; regenerate instead. The source asset is 'project-source', not the complete corresponding source: keep source_scope.complete=false until the upstream tree from the pinned commit is actually shipped or the offer is stated and signed off.
built_from: reviewed delivery snapshot; no rebuild, no network
git_commit_note: Bound after the candidate commit exists, via --git-commit <40 hex>. A null here means 'not yet committed', not 'no source'.

contains: this project's source, tests, tools and docs (source/)
the three host patches and Dockerfile.engine (source/upstream/patches/)
upstream lock: repository, commit, licence, change list (source/upstream/LOCK.md)

missing_components.reason: The upstream checkout is not present on the packaging host and downloading it is outside this task.

source_scope.how_to_complete: See SOURCE-ACCESS.md; verify matching source/build materials available to website users. Never mark complete just because a pinned URL exists.

evidence_scope.current_run: Local packaging/static verification only; no model calls or deployment; private raw evidence excluded.
